task: Rank error of the identical source-treatment-mean predictor in unseen whole cell lines
design: Plate1; all 4,443 observed pairs, 50 lines, 92 exact compound/dose labels, 2,000 fixed publisher genes; 157 absent pairs remain absent
outcome_scale: Released cell_eval response deltas, preserved without conversion; exact biological normalization unresolved
control_scale: Released plate-matched DMSO ref_mean, as named predictive covariates; never added to response
identity: Preserve exact treatment strings including whitespace and dose; no trimming/alias merging
numeric_policy: Fail on any nonfinite observed response; absent pairs masked, never zero-imputed as truth
outer_split: Existing frozen five ten-line folds; all responses of outer test lines excluded from fitting
inner_split: Four other frozen groups; each inner validation group entirely excluded from predictor, control transform, and rebuilt source LOO residual ledger
primary_prediction: Equal-source-line mean response per exact treatment; identical saved arrays for every ranking rule
support: No observed row excluded; fail if any scored treatment lacks at least 2 distinct source lines in an outer or inner fit

control_features.selection: top 2,048 positive across-source variances, tie by feature ID

loo_risk: For each source line/treatment, mean-gene squared error against the mean of other source lines; source-only ledger rebuilt inside inner training
kernel: Gaussian Euclidean distance in source-fitted control PCA; h0 median positive source-pair distance; no positive distances ->uniform
selection: Lowest equal-line inner MSE retained at 75%; exact ties uniform, then larger kappa, then larger bandwidth
redundancy: Treatment-only LOO risk = n/(n-1)*source sample variance; rankings identical at equal support
random_rule: ascending SHA256(EA-VC-Tahoe-v1|random20260910|context|repeat 0 to 99|exact-treatment); canonical reconstruction, all retained IDs exported
aggregation: mean genes within observed pair; mean retained treatments within line; average random repeats within line; equal mean lines overall and within each outer fold
gate: At 75%, candidate risk <=0.9 times globally best conventional risk and strictly below each fold's own best conventional in >=4/5 folds; zero conventional risk makes positive-margin gate fail
fold_gate_note: Fold-specific best is a conservative descriptive envelope, not a deployable selector. No per-line oracle method selection.
descriptive_ridge: Separate prediction-only comparison: same source-selected PCA, standardized by source PC standard deviations, per-treatment unpenalized intercept and ridge alpha 1 under mean-square objective; alpha fixed, no tuning; no uncertainty superiority claim
same_mask_checks: Zero and descriptive ridge scored on every retained mask; all primary rankers have equal mean-predictor loss at 100% coverage
uncertainty: 50 cell lines and 5 overlapping-training fits; no gene/row independence claim or calibrated probability/coverage guarantee
execution: Runner requires explicit --execute-real-data and external reviewed freeze manifest hashing every production file and this protocol
limits: Single cancer-cell chemical plate at 50 nM
Observed pairs only; missingness mechanism unresolved
Publisher panel may reflect outcome-informed feature selection
No biological mechanism or IDA superiority established
Existing local risk/shrinkage methods and Rhaister prior art credited
freeze_note: Local reviewed freeze, then published GitHub commit before evaluation; not external preregistration.
